Remarks

This struct provides a read-only or read-write reference to an FFmpeg channel layout. It implements IChannelLayout for accessing channel layout properties and supports copying and comparison operations.

SetReferencedObject(ChannelLayout?)

Sets the referenced channel layout to a new ChannelLayout object.

public void SetReferencedObject(ChannelLayout? obj)

Parameters

obj ChannelLayout

The ChannelLayout instance to set as the referenced object, or null to uninitialize the current layout.

Remarks

This method uses FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.av_channel_layout_copy(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVChannelLayout*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVChannelLayout*) to copy the layout from the specified ChannelLayout instance. If obj is null, it uses FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.av_channel_layout_uninit(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVChannelLayout*) to uninitialize the current layout.

Exceptions

NotSupportedException

Thrown if the current instance is read-only and cannot be modified. This occurs when IsReadOnly is true.

OutOfMemoryException

Thrown if there is insufficient memory to perform the operation. This can occur if FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.av_channel_layout_copy(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVChannelLayout*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVChannelLayout*) fails due to memory constraints.
